compos.summarization:
The smartphone UI screen displays a section titled "SALARY CHANGES" with two tabs: "Salary Increases" and "Salary Decreases." The current view is on the "Salary Increases" tab, showing a list of five players whose salaries have increased since they last played. Each entry includes the player's name, position, team, new salary, and the amount of the increase. 

The players listed are:
1. Guillermo Hernangómez, C (NY) - $5200 (+$900)
2. Mindaugas Kuzminskas, SF (NY) - $4200 (+$700)
3. Serge Ibaka, PF/C (TOR) - $6100 (+$600)
4. Harrison Barnes, SF/PF (DAL) - $6300 (+$400)
5. Terrence Ross, SF (ORL) - $5000 (+$400)

A note at the bottom indicates that additional salary changes are available for LineStar Premium members
